```{r}
clean_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    gsub("_gps", "", .)  # remove '_gps' suffix if not meaningful
}

table1 <- table1 %>%
  mutate(kultur_clean = clean_name(kultur))

table2 <- table2 %>%
  mutate(kultur_clean = clean_name(kultur))

table1_filled <- table1 %>%
  left_join(table2, by = "kultur_clean", suffix = c("", "_new")) %>%
  mutate(
    kulturartengruppe = coalesce(kulturartengruppe, kulturartengruppe_new)
  ) %>%
  select(kultur, kulturartengruppe)


# table1_filled %>% head(50)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Find common columns between the two data frames
common_columns <- intersect(names(result_2024), names(result_2025))

# Select only the matching columns from both data frames
result_2024_common <- result_2024[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]
result_2025_common <- result_2025[, common_columns, drop = FALSE]

# Get the common column names between both data frames
common_cols <- intersect(names(result_2024_common), names(result_2025_common))
```

### Leveling Groups 
```{r eval=FALSE}
# 1) Build ordered levels (handles values like "k_2022", "k2022", etc.)
ord_df <- tibble(gj = unique(as.character(gruppe8$group_jahr))) %>%
  mutate(
    # prefix: letters before underscore or before digits
    prefix = str_extract(gj, "^[A-Za-z]+") %>% tolower(),
    # year: first 4-digit number found
    year = str_extract(gj, "\\d{4}") %>% as.integer(),
    # numeric rank for the prefix so we get k -> 1, m -> 2, b -> 3
    prefix_rank = case_when(
      prefix == "k" ~ 1L,
      prefix == "m" ~ 2L,
      prefix == "b" ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ 4L
    )
  ) %>%
  # put rows with NA year at the end; within same year sort by prefix_rank
  arrange(is.na(year), year, prefix_rank, gj)

new_levels <- ord_df$gj

# 2) Apply factor levels to the main data and to the stats data used for lines
gruppe8 <- gruppe8 %>%
  mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))

# If gruppe1_stats contains group_jahr too, make sure it has the same factor levels
if ("gruppe1_stats" %in% ls()) {
  gruppe1_stats <- gruppe1_stats %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Define the variables you want statistics for
vars_to_summarise <- c("artenzahl_flora", "deckung_flora", "bluehende_pflanzen", "deckung_kultur", "hnv_taxa")


compute_stats <- function(data) { 
  data %>%
    group_by(group, jahr) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(vars_to_summarise),
             list(
               mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd = ~ifelse(length(na.omit(.x)) > 1, sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
               min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
             ),
             .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(group, jahr)  # Remove the fill = list() argument
}


# Split data by gruppe and compute stats for gruppe 1 and 8
gruppe_stats <- combined %>%
  filter(kulturartengruppe %in% c("1", "8")) %>%
  group_split(kulturartengruppe) %>%
  set_names(c("gruppe1", "gruppe8")) %>%
  map(compute_stats)

# Access results:
gruppe1_stats <- gruppe_stats$gruppe1
gruppe8_stats <- gruppe_stats$gruppe8

# Add a combined variable for plotting or further processing
gruppe1_stats <- gruppe1_stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_"))
gruppe8_stats <- gruppe8_stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_"))

# gruppe1_stats %>% names()
# gruppe8_stats %>% glimpse()
```



### Stats over all groups
```{r eval=FALSE}
## Statistical Prep - DRY Version (Fixed)

# Define the groups you want to analyze
target_groups <- c("1", "5", "6", "7", "8", "9")

# Define the variables you want statistics for
vars_to_summarise <- c("artenzahl_flora", "deckung_flora", "bluehende_pflanzen", 
                       "deckung_kultur", "hnv_taxa")

# Function to compute statistics
compute_stats <- function(data) { 
  data %>%
    group_by(group, jahr) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(vars_to_summarise),
             list(
               mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd = ~ifelse(length(na.omit(.x)) > 1, sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
               min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
               max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
             ),
             .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::complete(group, jahr)
}

# Function to create ordered factor levels for group_jahr
create_ordered_levels <- function(group_jahr_vector) {
  ord_df <- tibble(gj = unique(as.character(group_jahr_vector))) %>%
    mutate(
      prefix = str_extract(gj, "^[A-Za-z]+") %>% tolower(),
      year = str_extract(gj, "\\d{4}") %>% as.integer(),
      prefix_rank = case_when(
        prefix == "k" ~ 1L,
        prefix == "m" ~ 2L,
        prefix == "b" ~ 3L,
        TRUE ~ 4L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(is.na(year), year, prefix_rank, gj)
  
  return(ord_df$gj)
}

# Function to process each group
process_group <- function(data, group_number) {
  # Filter for specific kulturartengruppe
  filtered_data <- data %>% 
    filter(kulturartengruppe == group_number) %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_", drop = TRUE))
  
  # Create ordered levels and apply them
  new_levels <- create_ordered_levels(filtered_data$group_jahr)
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))
  
  return(filtered_data)
}

# Process all groups and create separate dataframes
gruppe_data <- target_groups %>%
  set_names(paste0("gruppe", .)) %>%
  map(~process_group(combined, .x))

# Compute statistics for all groups - FIXED VERSION
gruppe_stats_list <- target_groups %>%
  set_names(paste0("gruppe", ., "_stats")) %>%
  map(~{
    # Filter for this specific group
    data <- combined %>% filter(kulturartengruppe == .x)
    # Compute stats
    stats <- compute_stats(data)
    # Add group_jahr and apply ordered levels
    stats <- stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = interaction(group, jahr, sep = "_"))
    new_levels <- create_ordered_levels(stats$group_jahr)
    stats %>% mutate(group_jahr = factor(as.character(group_jahr), levels = new_levels))
  })

# Extract individual dataframes for easy access
list2env(gruppe_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
list2env(gruppe_stats_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# # Verify the objects exist
# cat("Created data objects:\n")
# ls(pattern = "^gruppe[0-9]$")
# cat("\nCreated stats objects:\n")
# ls(pattern = "^gruppe[0-9]_stats$")


# gruppe1, gruppe5, gruppe6, gruppe7, gruppe8, gruppe9 (filtered data with group_jahr)
# gruppe1_stats, gruppe5_stats, gruppe6_stats, gruppe7_stats, gruppe8_stats, gruppe9_stats

```

## Herbizidfreie Bewirtschaftung 

### artenzahl_flora

```{r}

#' ## Boxplots: x=Bewirtschaftung, y=Deckungsgrad_Kultur_prozent
ggplot(select_herbizidfrei, aes(group, artenzahl_flora)) + 
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey90") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_blank()) + # Remove x-axis text labels  ) 
  facet_wrap(~jahr, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "\n Herbizidfreie Bewirtschaftung", y = "Artenzahl Flora [n]\n") +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=23, size=4) +
  geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.2)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom='errorbar', linetype=1, width=0.5) # whiskers 
```

```{r}
                    labels = c("konventionell", "herbizidfrei", "ökologisch")) +
  labs(x = "\nBewirtschaftung",
       y = "Anzahl Blühpflanzen pro m² [n] \n",
       fill = "Bewirtschaftung") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"  
  )
```



### log10(Anzahl Blütenpflanzen)

```{r}
ggplot(combined_25, aes(x = factor(group, levels = c("k", "m", "b"),
                                   labels = c("konventionell", "herbizidfrei", "ökologisch")),
                        y = log10(bluehende_pflanzen + 1), fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_boxplot(geom = 'errorbar', width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 4, fill = "white") +
  geom_jitter(shape = 16, position = position_jitter(0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("k" = "grey90", "m" = "grey70", "b" = "grey50"),
                    labels = c("konventionell", "herbizidfrei", "ökologisch")) +
  labs(x = "\nBewirtschaftung",
       y = "log10(Anzahl Blühpflanzen pro m² + 1) [n]\n",
       fill = "Bewirtschaftung") +

  )
```
